use_case_requirements: Workloads: secure customer-facing chat, embeddings for risk detection, document search with PII filters. Latency target: p95 <= 120ms for typical chats (US region). Throughput: 50 concurrent users peak, burst to 200 req/s for batch scoring. Model prefs: prefer open/quantized backbone (similar to Llama-family variants) but must support fallback to smaller models for cost. Routing needs: primary-hosted in private VPC, automated fallback to dedicated in same region if capacity constrained. Encryption: customer-managed keys (BYOK) with HSM attestation, key rotation every 90 days, support envelope encryption. Audit: detailed per-request audit logs forwarded to customer's SIEM; retention 7 years. Compliance: SSO/SAML, SOC2/ISO27001 evidence required for procurement.
